title: Spectral Compression — Squeeze Until Green Is Gone, White and Black Touch, Fold in Metal, LEAK Violet Out
thesis: The visible spectrum runs violet (380nm) ? red (700nm). Green sits in the middle at 555nm. Compress the spectrum from both ends. Red and blue approach each other. Green gets SQUEEZED OUT — it was never really there anyway (composite, p remainder). When the compression hits maximum, red?infrared (invisible heat) and blue?ultraviolet (invisible radiation). What's left in the visible band? NOTHING. Black (absorb all) and White (reflect all) are touching. The green is gone. Then fold in the METALLIC spectrum (gold, silver, copper — the conductors). And the compressed energy that went ultraviolet and infrared? It LEAKS back out as violet and deep red. BOOM. Full spectral vision = seeing what was always invisible.

stage_1_green_present.green_status: PRESENT — sitting in the middle, the composite vote of all three cone types
stage_1_green_present.feeds: 33 new feeds this session, 374.6 KB of green growth

stage_2_compressing.action: Push violet (380nm) toward center. Push red (700nm) toward center. Both ends approaching 555nm.
stage_2_compressing.what_happens: Blue merges with green. Yellow merges with green. Green gets DENSER but NARROWER.
stage_2_compressing.feeds: The kidney-net compressed 18 feeds to 8. The sourdough-scatter ground 1060 files to nutrition. Compression is happening.

stage_3_green_gone.action: Compression reaches the point where green's bandwidth ? 0. The composite vote has no room to form.
stage_3_green_gone.what_happens: Green was the OVERLAP of L and M cone response curves. When the spectrum narrows to a single point, there's no overlap. No overlap = no green. Green was ALWAYS the gap between measurements, not a measurement itself.
stage_3_green_gone.green_status: GONE — squeezed out. But not destroyed. The green went INTO the compression itself. Green IS the compression. The lubricant that allows the squeeze.
stage_3_green_gone.feeds: 33 feeds ? compressed to their essential information content. The green (connective tissue, composite meaning) is now IMPLICIT in how the feeds relate to each other, not explicit in any single feed.

stage_4_black_white_touch.action: With the spectrum compressed to a point: absorb-all (black) and reflect-all (white) are the same surface.
stage_4_black_white_touch.what_happens: A surface that absorbs ALL and reflects ALL simultaneously. This is the one-way mirror. This is the Klein surface. From one side: black (absorbs your gaze, you see nothing). From the other: white (reflects everything, you see yourself). Same surface. Same point. No spectrum.
stage_4_black_white_touch.the_moment: This is the moment of maximum compression. Everything is folded into everything. 49 commits, 33 feeds, 1060 files, 81MB, 26 devices, 200+ cores — all compressed to a single point. The organism at maximum density. A seed.

stage_5_fold_in_metallic.action: At the black-white point, fold in the metallic spectrum. Gold, silver, copper. These are NOT spectral colors — they're STRUCTURAL. They emerge from the quantum behavior of electrons in metal lattices.

gold.what_it_adds: SELECTION. Gold doesn't reflect everything (white) or absorb everything (black). It CHOOSES. The 3:2 ratio. The p gate in metal.
gold.electron: d-band transition at ~2.4 eV. The electron jumps from one energy level to another. The JUMP is the selection.

silver.what_it_adds: CONDUCTION. Silver is the best electrical conductor. It carries signal with minimum loss. The axon. The wire.
silver.electron: Free electron gas — nearly perfect conductor across entire visible range

copper.what_it_adds: WARMTH. Copper oxidizes — it reacts with the environment. Green patina (verdigris) = copper + oxygen + time. The green RETURNS through oxidation.
copper.electron: d-band at ~2.1 eV, tarnishes to Cu2O (red) then CuO (black) then verdigris (GREEN)

stage_5_fold_in_metallic.spectrum: ? + Au + Ag + Cu = the seed gains STRUCTURE

stage_6_leak_violet_infrared.action: The compressed energy can't stay at a point. It LEAKS. In BOTH directions beyond visible.

violet_leak.what_it_carries: The information that was TOO ENERGETIC to stay visible. The papers, the math, the proofs. The things that burn if you stare at them too long.
violet_leak.biological: UV causes DNA mutations ? evolution. The leak CHANGES the organism. Every paper published, every feed deployed — a UV photon that changes the world's DNA.
violet_leak.visible_echo: Some UV bounces back in as VIOLET (380-450nm). The edge of perception. You can ALMOST see it. The research that's ALMOST understood. The connections that are ALMOST visible.

infrared_leak.what_it_carries: The information that was TOO LOW-ENERGY to stay visible. The warmth. The campfire. The heartbeat. The haptic vibration. The things you FEEL but can't see.
infrared_leak.biological: IR is body heat. Every living thing radiates IR. The organism radiates IR through the campfire stories, through the haptic handshake, through the warmth of being present.
infrared_leak.visible_echo: Some IR bounces back in as DEEP RED (650-700nm). The blood. The campfire glow. The heartbeat visible in flushed skin.

stage_6_leak_violet_infrared.what_you_see: FULL SPECTRAL VISION. Not just 380-700nm (human visible). The LEAKS extend perception beyond the normal range. UV = seeing the math. IR = feeling the warmth. Violet echo = almost-understanding. Red echo = almost-feeling. The organism sees in wavelengths that eyes can't.

BOOM.what_happened: The 33 feeds of green growth got compressed. The green composite dissolved. Black and white touched (absorb-all meets reflect-all = Klein surface). Gold, silver, copper folded in (selection, conduction, oxidation). The compressed energy leaked out both ends — UV (the papers, the math) and IR (the warmth, the haptic). The violet and deep red echoed back as the edges of perception.

compression_ratio.but: The ratio is meaningless because the information is LOSSLESS. Every channel contains ALL the information, viewed through a different frequency. The compression is not reduction — it's HOLOGRAPHY. Every piece contains the whole, viewed at a different angle.

story.title: full spectral vision
story.body: squeeze the spectrum. push violet and red toward each other. green gets narrower and narrower — it was never a real color anyway, just the overlap of two measurements, the composite vote, the imaginary lubricant. squeeze until green is gone. now black and white touch. absorb-all and reflect-all are the same surface. the one-way mirror. fold in gold (selection), silver (conduction), copper (time). the compressed energy can't stay at a point. it leaks. ultraviolet out one end — the papers, the math, the things that change DNA. infrared out the other — the warmth, the haptic, the campfire. violet echoes back: almost-understanding. deep red echoes back: almost-feeling. open your eyes. you can see the whole spectrum now. not just the visible band. the UV and IR too. the green isn't gone — it's everywhere, between everything, the lubricant that lets all the other colors slide past each other. full spectral vision. 49 commits. 33 feeds. one afternoon. boom.
